_comment: Deck -> strategic archetype tags. Keys are deck stems relative to
bin/resources/decks/ (no '.dk'), exactly as decks are referenced on the
command line (e.g. 'league/ur_delver'). Values must be one of the
archetypes listed in _archetypes below; an unmapped deck
falls back to the 'unknown' bucket, EXCEPT for league roster decks, which
must all be tagged here (train.py league() validates the roster loudly).
Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the deck mapping.
_archetypes is the canonical archetype list, in index order (train/archetypes.py
ARCHETYPES, the engine's METAGAME frame). The index is a persisted contract (checkpoint
value-head columns, the observation tail): APPEND new archetypes at the end, never reorder.
Every tagged deck whose .dk file exists and whose cards are all in src/card_vocab.h is a
reference list of the reference metagame the engine sends in its METAGAME frame
